passages.text: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He gave it to the choirmaster.
The choirmaster led music in worship.
This psalm is for worship.

passages.text: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
David speaks to the LORD.
David says, "I have taken refuge in You, O LORD."
David asks the LORD, "Do not let me be put to shame."
David asks the LORD, "Save me by Your righteousness."
passages.original: לַמְנַצֵּ֗חַ מִזְמ֥וֹר לְדָוִֽד׃ בְּךָ֖ יְהוָ֣ה חָ֭סִיתִי אַל־ אֵב֣וֹשָׁה לְעוֹלָ֑ם בְּצִדְקָתְךָ֥ פַלְּטֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: Incline Your ear to me; come quickly to my rescue. Be my rock of refuge, the stronghold of my deliverance.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm for the choirmaster.
David speaks to the LORD.
David asks God to listen to him.
David says, “Turn Your ear to me.”
David asks God to come quickly.
David says, “Rescue me soon.”
David asks God to be his rock.
David says, “Be my place of safety.”
David asks God to be his stronghold.
David says, “Be my strong house to save me.”
passages.original: הַטֵּ֤ה אֵלַ֨י׀ אָזְנְךָ֮ מְהֵרָ֪ה הַצִּ֫ילֵ֥נִי הֱיֵ֤ה לִ֨י׀ לְֽצוּר־ מָ֭עוֹז לְבֵ֥ית מְצוּד֗וֹת לְהוֹשִׁיעֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to the LORD.
David trusts the LORD.
The LORD is strong like a rock.
The LORD protects like a fortress.
The LORD leads David.
The LORD guides David.
The LORD does this for the sake of His name.
passages.original: כִּֽי־ סַלְעִ֣י וּמְצוּדָתִ֣י אָ֑תָּה וּלְמַ֥עַן שִׁ֝מְךָ֗ תַּֽנְחֵ֥נִי וּֽתְנַהֲלֵֽנִי׃

passages.text: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
passages.sermon: God is my refuge.\r\nEnemies set a net for me.\r\nYou free me from their trap.
passages.original: תּוֹצִיאֵ֗נִי מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת ז֭וּ טָ֣מְנוּ לִ֑י כִּֽי־ אַ֝תָּה מָֽעוּזִּֽי׃

passages.text: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The LORD is the God of truth.
The speaker commits his spirit into the LORD’s hands.
The LORD has redeemed the speaker.
passages.original: בְּיָדְךָ֮ אַפְקִ֪יד ר֫וּחִ֥י פָּדִ֖יתָה אוֹתִ֥י יְהוָ֗ה אֵ֣ל אֱמֶֽת׃

passages.text: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
passages.sermon: I hate people who hold on to worthless idols.\r\nI trust in the LORD.\r\n
passages.original: שָׂנֵ֗אתִי הַשֹּׁמְרִ֥ים הַבְלֵי־ שָׁ֑וְא וַ֝אֲנִ֗י אֶל־ יְהוָ֥ה בָּטָֽחְתִּי׃

passages.text: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
passages.sermon:
God is loving and faithful.
God sees my suffering.
God knows the pain in my soul.
I will be glad.
I will rejoice because of God's loving devotion.
passages.original: אָגִ֥ילָה וְאֶשְׂמְחָ֗ה בְּחַ֫סְדֶּ֥ךָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָ֭אִיתָ אֶת־ עָנְיִ֑י יָ֝דַ֗עְתָּ בְּצָר֥וֹת נַפְשִֽׁי׃

passages.text: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
passages.sermon:
God protects me.
God does not hand me over to my enemy.
God keeps me safe.
God places my feet in a wide, open place.
God gives me freedom and security.
passages.original: וְלֹ֣א הִ֭סְגַּרְתַּנִי בְּיַד־ אוֹיֵ֑ב הֶֽעֱמַ֖דְתָּ בַמֶּרְחָ֣ב רַגְלָֽי׃

passages.text: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is in distress.
The speaker asks the LORD for mercy.
The speaker’s eyes are weak from sorrow.
The speaker’s soul is weak.
The speaker’s body is weak.
passages.original: חָנֵּ֥נִי יְהוָה֮ כִּ֤י צַ֫ר־ לִ֥י עָשְׁשָׁ֖ה בְכַ֥עַס עֵינִ֗י נַפְשִׁ֥י וּבִטְנִֽי׃

passages.text: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is a person in deep distress.
This person suffers because of grief.
Grief fills every part of this person's life.
Every year passes with groaning and sorrow.
Sin has made this person weak.
Strength has left this person because of iniquity.
The person's bones are wasting away.
passages.original: כִּ֤י כָל֪וּ בְיָג֡וֹן חַיַּי֮ וּשְׁנוֹתַ֪י בַּאֲנָ֫חָ֥ה כָּשַׁ֣ל בַּעֲוֺנִ֣י כֹחִ֑י וַעֲצָמַ֥י עָשֵֽׁשׁוּ׃

passages.text: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
passages.sermon:
I am a disgrace among all my enemies.
I am an even greater disgrace among my neighbors.
My friends are afraid of me.
When my friends see me on the street, they run away from me.
passages.original: מִכָּל־ צֹרְרַ֨י הָיִ֪יתִי חֶרְפָּ֡ה וְלִשֲׁכֵנַ֨י׀ מְאֹד֮ וּפַ֪חַד לִֽמְיֻדָּ֫עָ֥י רֹאַ֥י בַּח֑וּץ נָדְד֥וּ מִמֶּֽנִּי׃

passages.text: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
passages.sermon:
The speaker is David.
David feels forgotten.
People do not remember David.
David is like a dead man.
No one thinks about David.
David is like a broken vessel.
David feels useless and discarded.
passages.original: נִ֭שְׁכַּחְתִּי כְּמֵ֣ת מִלֵּ֑ב הָ֝יִ֗יתִי כִּכְלִ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃

passages.text: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
passages.sermon:
Many people speak evil about me.
I hear their slander.
Fear surrounds me.
They join together against me.
They make plans to kill me.
passages.original: כִּ֤י שָׁמַ֨עְתִּי׀ דִּבַּ֥ת רַבִּים֮ מָג֪וֹר מִסָּ֫בִ֥יב בְּהִוָּסְדָ֣ם יַ֣חַד עָלַ֑י לָקַ֖חַת נַפְשִׁ֣י זָמָֽמוּ׃

passages.text: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
passages.sermon: I trust in You, LORD.\r\nI say, “You are my God.”
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ עָלֶ֣יךָ בָטַ֣חְתִּי יְהוָ֑ה אָ֝מַ֗רְתִּי אֱלֹהַ֥י אָֽתָּה׃

passages.text: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
passages.sermon:
God, You hold my life in Your hands.
You control all my days.
You have power over my future.
Rescue me from my enemies.
Save me from those who chase me.
My safety depends on You.
passages.original: בְּיָדְךָ֥ עִתֹּתָ֑י הַצִּ֘ילֵ֤נִי מִיַּד־ א֝וֹיְבַ֗י וּמֵרֹדְפָֽי׃

passages.text: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
passages.sermon:
The speaker addresses the LORD.
The speaker calls himself God's servant.
The speaker asks God to make His face shine on him.
The speaker asks God to save him.
The speaker asks God to save him by God's loving devotion.
passages.original: הָאִ֣ירָה פָ֭נֶיךָ עַל־ עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ ה֖וֹשִׁיעֵ֣נִי בְחַסְדֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
passages.sermon:
O LORD, I call on You.
I trust You to help me.
Do not let me be ashamed.
Let the wicked be put to shame instead.
Let the wicked become silent in Sheol, the place of the dead.
passages.original: יְֽהוָ֗ה אַל־ אֵ֭בוֹשָׁה כִּ֣י קְרָאתִ֑יךָ יֵבֹ֥שׁוּ רְ֝שָׁעִ֗ים יִדְּמ֥וּ לִשְׁאֽוֹל׃

passages.text: May lying lips be silenced— lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
passages.sermon:
Lying lips speak with arrogance.
These lips speak against the righteous.
They are full of pride.
They show contempt.
May God silence these lying lips.
passages.original: תֵּ֥אָלַ֗מְנָה שִׂפְתֵ֫י שָׁ֥קֶר הַדֹּבְר֖וֹת עַל־ צַדִּ֥יק עָתָ֗ק בְּגַאֲוָ֥ה וָבֽוּז׃

passages.text: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is good.
The LORD stores up great goodness.
He keeps this goodness for those who fear Him.
He gives this goodness to people who take refuge in Him.
He shows this goodness openly before all people.
passages.original: מָ֤ה רַֽב־ טוּבְךָ֮ אֲשֶׁר־ צָפַ֪נְתָּ לִּֽירֵ֫אֶ֥יךָ פָּ֭עַלְתָּ לַחֹסִ֣ים בָּ֑ךְ נֶ֝֗גֶד בְּנֵ֣י אָדָם׃

passages.text: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
passages.sermon:
God protects the righteous.
God hides them in the secret place of His presence.
He keeps them safe from the schemes of men.
God conceals them in His shelter.
He shields them from accusing tongues.
passages.original: תַּסְתִּירֵ֤ם׀ בְּסֵ֥תֶר פָּנֶיךָ֮ מֵֽרֻכְסֵ֫י אִ֥ישׁ תִּצְפְּנֵ֥ם בְּסֻכָּ֗ה מֵרִ֥יב לְשֹׁנֽוֹת׃

passages.text: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
passages.sermon: The LORD is blessed.\r\nThe LORD has shown me His loving devotion.\r\nHe did this while I was in a city under siege.
passages.original: בָּר֥וּךְ יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֥י הִפְלִ֘יא חַסְדּ֥וֹ לִ֝֗י בְּעִ֣יר מָצֽוֹר׃

passages.text: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
David felt afraid.
David spoke quickly because of his fear.
David said, “I am cut off from Your sight.”
David thought God could not see him.
But God heard David’s voice.
David cried out to God for help.
God listened to David’s plea for mercy.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ אָ֘מַ֤רְתִּי בְחָפְזִ֗י נִגְרַזְתִּי֮ מִנֶּ֪גֶד עֵ֫ינֶ֥יךָ אָכֵ֗ן שָׁ֭מַעְתָּ ק֥וֹל תַּחֲנוּנַ֗י בְּשַׁוְּעִ֥י אֵלֶֽיךָ׃

passages.text: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has saints.
Saints are people who belong to God.
Love the LORD, all you saints.
The LORD preserves faithful people.
Faithful people trust and obey God.
The LORD fully repays arrogant people.
Arrogant people act with pride against God.
passages.original: אֶֽהֱב֥וּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה כָּֽל־ חֲסִ֫ידָ֥יו אֱ֭מוּנִים נֹצֵ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה וּמְשַׁלֵּ֥ם עַל־ יֶ֝֗תֶר עֹשֵׂ֥ה גַאֲוָֽה׃

passages.text: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
passages.sermon:
This message is for all people who hope in the LORD.
The LORD is God.
He is faithful and powerful.
You must be strong.
You must have courage in your heart.
Trust in the LORD as you wait for Him.
passages.original: חִ֭זְקוּ וְיַאֲמֵ֣ץ לְבַבְכֶ֑ם כָּל־ הַ֝מְיַחֲלִ֗ים לַיהוָֽה׃
